item.text:
Added a Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:1) that validates the submitted title and body, creates a post, and calls `updateTag('posts')`. The posts list reads through a cached function tagged with `posts` in [lib/posts.ts](/workspace/lib/posts.ts:1). `updateTag` immediately expires that cache, so the next read fetches fresh data.

The page now includes a create form and renders the posts in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1). TypeScript check passed with `npx tsc --noEmit`.

There’s no database configured in this starter, so posts are stored in server-process memory and won’t persist across restarts or reliably across multiple server instances. Replace that store with the app’s database when available; the `updateTag('posts')` invalidation can remain as is.
